nameEn: Manufacture of metal-forming machinery and machine tools
description: This class includes the manufacture of machine tools for working metal and other materials, and metal-forming machinery.
includes: manufacture of machine tools for working metal: lathes, milling machines, boring machines, drilling machines, grinding machines, honing machines, lapping machines, sharpening machines
manufacture of metal-forming machinery: forging machines, stamping machines, pressing machines, bending machines, folding machines, straightening machines
manufacture of machining centres for working metal
manufacture of machine tools for cutting, punching, shearing metal
manufacture of presses for working metal
manufacture of machines for working stone, ceramics, concrete, glass: cutting, grinding, polishing machines
manufacture of machinery for working wood, cork, bone, hard rubber, hard plastics and similar hard materials: saws, milling machines
excludes: manufacture of interchangeable tools for machine tools, see 2593
manufacture of electronic machine tools, see 2620
manufacture of machinery for mining, see 2824
